individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each marker is itself an individual sample measurement; marginal histograms show distributions, not averages.
Scatter plot type is exempt from requiring overlaid raw replicates, even though each point here represents a per-cell-line mean with s.d. error bars.
Line plot of fitted probability density curves; line plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Box plot (exempt by type) that additionally overlays the individual ridge-length data points per sample within each box.
Polar histogram representing the full distribution of phase differences; histograms are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Polar histogram of subtype-averaged phase differences; histogram type is exempt.
Line plot showing a single example raw signal trace with its fitted curve, not an average across samples; line plots are exempt.
Scatter plot where each point is a sample's fitted parameter with uncertainty error bars; scatter plots are exempt from the overlay requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Scatter plot of individual sample measurements with marginal histograms; no error bars are present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean ± s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5])
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars on the scatter points are explicitly defined as mean plus/minus s.d. in the caption.
Density curve plot without error bars.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot elements (box edges, whiskers, median, outliers) are fully defined in the caption.
Single example trace with fitted/decay curves; no statistical error bars present.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars on amplitude and decay rate values are explicitly defined as the s.d. of the fitted parameters.
